triples.subject: apparatus_xps
triples.context: The incident photon energy was calibrated prior to the beam-time by conducting X-ray photoemission spectroscopy (XPS) measurement of 4felectrons from the thin Au foil using an XPS apparatus, which was located downstream of our EBIT.

triples.subject: mirror_kbSystem
triples.context: A Kirkpatrick Baez (KB) mirror [42] system refocuses the photon beam at the position of the JAXA-EBIT trap region a few meters downstream.
